# Unicode line break conformance fixture

- Unicode version: 17.0.0 (UAX #14 revision 55).
- Source: https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/auxiliary/LineBreakTest.txt
- Original SHA-256: `e69884e0dde6a8724873f885d68c52dc14518abf9ae4ca9e2283b8773db3b752`.
- `LineBreakTest.txt.gz` is the unchanged official corpus, gzip-compressed with
  a zero timestamp. Tests verify the digest before running the default rules.
- Unicode data is distributed under the adjacent `LICENSE.txt`.
- Dictionary segmentation and emergency alphabetic wrapping are application
  tailoring and are covered separately by TextField tests.
